name: 使用 SAP Ariba Invoicing 的发票处理 (7YH)
name_en: Invoice Processing with SAP Ariba Invoicing (7YH)
description_en_html:
Overview

SAP Ariba Invoicing on SAP BTP provides a unified solution for receiving and managing supplier invoices, with connection to multiple systems, such as SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition systems. This business solution contains a variety of applications to help you import supplier invoices with precise parameters and manage them in a unified interface. SAP Ariba Invoicing supports the display of invoice attachments in a split screen, as well as a seamless navigation to SAP Fiori apps for invoices or SAP GUI transactions from connected systems. It also provides various options to authorize specific invoice access to different user groups. The SAP Ariba Invoicing, inbound processing module provides embedded invoice inbound processing services, including OCR. This additional module allows users to upload invoice files, edit draft invoices, and save supplier invoices directly to the connected backend system.

Note:

This scope item applies to all countries and regions and is not country- or region-specific.

Key Process Flow

  • Receive incoming invoices
  • Process invoice data
  • Approve invoices

Business Benefits

  • Streamline invoice processes in an efficient and cost-effective manner
  • Centralize invoice processing in a multi-backend environment
  • Get the newest process automation solutions
  • Reduce manual invoice interaction
  • Monitor accounts payable invoice handling progress in real time
  • Connect multiple invoice input channels centrally
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP BTP 上的 SAP Ariba Invoicing 提供用于接收和管理供应商发票的统一解决方案，并连接到多个系统，例如 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统。此业务解决方案包含各种应用程序，可帮助您导入具有精确参数的供应商发票，并在统一界面中管理这些发票。SAP Ariba Invoicing 支持在拆分屏幕中显示发票附件，以及从连接的系统无缝导航到 SAP Fiori 应用的发票或 SAP GUI 事务。它还提供了各种选项，以授权不同用户组访问特定发票。SAP Ariba Invoicing 内向处理模块提供嵌入式发票内向处理服务，包括 OCR。此附加模块允许用户上载发票文件、编辑草稿发票并将供应商发票直接保存到连接的后端系统。

注释：

此范围项目适用于所有国家和地区，并非特定于国家或地区。

关键流程流

  • 接收采购发票
  • 处理发票数据
  • 审批发票

业务优势

  • 以经济有效的方式简化发票流程
  • 在多后端环境中集中处理发票
  • 获取最新的流程自动化解决方案
  • 减少手动发票交互
  • 实时监控应付账款发票处理进度
  • 集中连接多个发票输入渠道
